text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Chairman of Hong Kong Trade Development Council, Victor Fung, says cooperation between Hong Kong and Shanghai will be the key word after Chinese takeover of Hong Kong.
- President of the Shanghai Stock Exchange, Yang Xianghai, says the Hong Kong and Shanghai stock exchanges will both work independently and cooperate after the Hong Kong handover.

- The latest batch of state debt issue starting March 1 has sold well with over 25 percent or 31.1 billion yuan of the total issue of 123 billion yuan being sold. The issue will last until October 20.

- BUSINESS NEWS - General Motors Corp signed an agreement with Shanghai Automotive Industry Corp to set up a $1.57 billion car joint venture in the Pudong New Area in Shanghai. The agreement was signed on Tuesday in Beijing.
- The 32nd world congress of the International Chamber of Commerce will be held in Shanghai from April 7 to 10.
- Commentary says China holds too many trade fairs without boosting foreign trade.
